# UX Checklist: Multi-File Upload (015 + 017)

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the upload dialog's interaction, accessibility, and feedback requirements across 015-file-upload-ui and 017-multi-file-upload
**Created**: 2026-09-18
**Feature**: specs/017-multi-file-upload/spec.md (extends specs/015-file-upload-ui/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Interaction Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are drop-target visual requirements specified for all three states (idle, drag-hover, upload-locked)? [Completeness, 017 Spec §FR-002, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for drops containing no files (dropped text, URLs) as distinct from invalid-file drops? [Completeness, 017 Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are duplicate-across-passes requirements specified at the user-facing level (what the admin sees), beyond the server-dedupe assumption? [Gap, 017 Spec US3, Assumptions]

## Interaction Consistency

- [ ] CHK004 - Are per-file rejection requirements consistent between picker and drop paths (naming the file, aggregation, start-action gating)? [Consistency, 017 Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the upload-time queue lock reflected consistently across pick, drop, and remove requirements? [Consistency, 017 Spec §FR-006; 015 Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 - Do the drop-decline requirements align between the hover affordance, the locked hint text, and the OS cursor behavior? [Consistency, 017 Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "clearly marked drop area" defined with verifiable visual properties rather than a subjective adjective? [Measurability, 017 Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the locked-queue hint text content specified, or only its existence? [Clarity, 017 Spec Clarifications]

## Accessibility Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 - Are keyboard-operation requirements defined for the drop path given the drop area itself is not focusable — is the Add-files equivalence explicit in requirements? [Coverage, 017 Spec Edge Cases; 015 Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are screen-reader announcement requirements defined for queue additions via drop ( distinct from open/progress/outcome announcements)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are touch-target (≥44px) and theme (Light/Dark/High Contrast) requirements specified for the new drop-target visuals, including the drag-hover highlight? [Coverage, 017 Spec §FR-009]

## Cross-Spec Alignment

- [ ] CHK012 - Do the 017 intake requirements preserve every 015 guarantee (auto-close only on full success, stay-open on failure, dismiss-cancels, retry semantics) without contradiction? [Consistency, 015 Spec §FR-006–FR-008; 017 Spec §FR-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
